response.justification: Bogdan is a highly experienced software engineer with over 15 years of industry experience, significantly exceeding the 6+ years requirement. He demonstrates deep expertise in the primary stack (TypeScript, Node.js, React) and possesses the niche required skill of AI agent development. His strong background in software craftsmanship, testing, and cloud infrastructure makes him an exceptional fit for this Senior Fullstack Developer role.
strengths: Extensive full-stack experience with the primary tech stack, including advanced usage of TypeScript, Node.js, and React.
Direct, recent experience building AI-agent infrastructure and Model Context Protocol (MCP) tooling.
Exceptional background in testing (TDD, CI/CD) and architecture, including creating custom testing libraries and teaching developer workshops.
concerns: Specific frameworks mentioned in the job description (Nest.js and Vitest) are not explicitly listed on the resume.
Limited recent professional exposure to Kotlin or Python, which are listed as secondary/required languages.
Having held Staff Engineer and Founder titles, he may be overqualified or seeking more strategic leadership than a standard individual contributor role provides.
